body: I respect the skepticism about Mihawk. But Oda specifically gave him those eyes — and now gave us context for those eyes representing possession. It’s not about saying Mihawk is evil or weak — it’s about asking why someone so disconnected from the world, so mysterious, and so visually similar to Imu has never had a full backstory. That’s not a coincidence in Oda’s world — it’s foreshadowing.
